hast:
The official website for shadcn/ui is ui.shadcn.com.

Official resources

  • Website: ui.shadcn.com is the official website and component documentation.
  • Source code: github.com/shadcn-ui/ui is the official source repository for shadcn/ui and the CLI.
  • CLI package: npmjs.com/package/shadcn is the official shadcn package published on npm.
  • Project updates: @shadcn publishes official announcements and project updates.

Third-party resources

Community websites and registries may use shadcn/ui components or the shadcn CLI, but they are independent unless they are explicitly identified as maintained by shadcn/ui on this page.

Review third-party code before installing it in your project. Browse community-maintained registries in the official Registry Directory.
